### Function 3 - Codon generation

The `codon_sequence()` function takes the RNA sequence as a single string and splits it into a vector of codons.

```{r}
rna_sequence -> "UCUAGAUCCCGA"
c_sequence -> codon_sequence(rna_sequence)

c_sequence
```
